sources.label: Associated Press
claims: Rounds described limits on informal engagements.
The Pentagon said NORAD, NATO and defense intelligence sharing are unaffected.
Canada’s defence minister reported no operational change.
sources.evidence_excerpt: AP reported remarks by Rounds, Parnell and McGuinty, including the continuing joint counter-drug work.

sources.label: The Washington Post
claims: Hegseth circulated classified guidance, whose full text remains unavailable.
sources.evidence_excerpt: Officials familiar with the directive described classified guidance. The Post said it had not reviewed the memo.
